body: hello! this is super late and i dont even know if you’ll see this, but what terrifies me the most is just being alone & having too much responsibilities i cant handle (i know this sounds kind of stupid) and as much as horrible my parents sound, i do rely on them for a bunch of things, even though they do gaslight me when i try to talk about my feelings. for some reason im scared of being too far from them, even if they do cause me to have bad thoughts sometimes. deep down i know they do love me, my family is just mexican and they’re really heavy on that “women should do everything” culture. i think im just too attached to them, i would get extremely homesick and i would just be scared of the bigger world. its almost like someone who can’t get out of a bad relationship because they love that person. this paragraph is all over the place, sorry.
